zh: 孩子们在楼上玩。
en: The kids are playing {upstairs}.

zh: 关门小声点，宝宝睡着了。
en: Close the door {quietly|gently|softly}, the baby is asleep.

zh: 出门前一定要把门锁好。
en: Make sure you lock the door {properly|securely} before you leave.

zh: 我总是忘记把垃圾桶推出去。
en: I {always|constantly} forget to take the bins out.

zh: 我们最近搬进了新房子。
en: We've {recently} moved into a new house.

zh: 洗的衣服差不多干了。
en: The washing is {almost|nearly} dry.

zh: 水龙头一直不停地滴水，快把我逼疯了。
en: The tap is {constantly|always|continually} dripping, and it's driving me mad.

zh: 她把毛巾叠得整整齐齐。
en: She folded the towels {neatly|tidily}.

zh: 晚饭很快就好。
en: Dinner will be ready {soon|shortly}.

zh: 意面要煮十分钟。与此同时，你可以做沙拉。
en: The pasta takes ten minutes. {Meanwhile|In the meantime}, you can make the salad.

zh: 我几乎不认识我的邻居。
en: I {hardly|barely|scarcely} know my neighbours.

zh: 把盖子拧紧。
en: Screw the lid on {tightly|tight|firmly}.

zh: 这房子冬天还算暖和。
en: The house is {fairly|quite|pretty|reasonably} warm in winter.

zh: 雨下得很大，我们今天就待在屋里吧。
en: It's pouring, so let's stay {inside|indoors|in|home} today.

zh: 水管工据说明天来，但我得亲眼看到才信。
en: The plumber is {supposedly|apparently} coming tomorrow, but I'll believe it when I see it.

zh: 厨房基本上完工了，只差刷漆。
en: The kitchen is {basically|essentially|practically|pretty much|more or less|almost|nearly|mostly} finished; we just need to paint it.

zh: 做饭前把蔬菜彻底洗干净。
en: Rinse the vegetables {thoroughly|well|properly} before cooking.

zh: 我和室友相处得很好。
en: My flatmate and I get on {well}.

zh: 我们很少用那间空房。
en: We {rarely|seldom|hardly ever|almost never} use the spare room.

zh: 我们看不了电视，于是改成打牌了。
en: We couldn't watch TV, so we played cards {instead}.
